The creamiest vegan chickpea curry 🍛 ready in 30 minutes, one pan only!

Ingredients (serves 4):
- 2 tbsp coconut oil
- 1 onion, diced
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tbsp grated fresh ginger
- 2 tbsp curry powder
- 1 tsp ground turmeric
- 2 cans (400 g each) chickpeas, drained
- 1 can (400 ml) coconut milk
- 1 cup crushed tomatoes
- 2 cups fresh spinach
- salt to taste
- juice of 1/2 lime

Method:
1. Heat the oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
2. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder and turmeric, stir for 1 minute.
3. Add chickpeas, coconut milk and tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Stir in the spinach until wilted, season with salt and finish with lime juice.

Serve with rice or naan. Save it for later! 👇
#vegancurry #plantbased #easyrecipes
